title: 'Jellyfish' probe the radar beam and are seen flying in a pair
summary: Skywatcher tells of 'Jellyfish' probe the radar beam and are seen flying in a pair, about February (c. 2025) at Skywatcher site, about 6 km to the north and south, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
